items.abstract:
<jats:p>
            We have designed and operated a superconducting tunnel junction circuit that behaves as a two-level atom: the “quantronium.” An arbitrary evolution of its quantum state can be programmed with a series of microwave pulses, and a projective measurement of the state can be performed by a pulsed readout subcircuit. The measured quality factor of quantum coherence
            <jats:italic>Q</jats:italic>
            <jats:sub>ϕ</jats:sub>
            ≅ 25,000 is sufficiently high that a solid-state quantum processor based on this type of circuit can be envisioned.
          </jats:p>
title: Manipulating the Quantum State of an Electrical Circuit
